releaseTitle: AdSkip Pro v1.0.3 - Intelligent Ad Skipping & Autonomous Episode Unlocking
releaseNotes:
* Fixed ad classification conflict where ads were misclassified as transition screens
* Tightened unlock button regexes to prevent false matching inside video ads
* Added 2.5s throttling to visual screenshot perception to prevent IPC crashes
* Reduced stuck ad back-press fallback to 12s
* Restored bare corner dismissal logic in node tree scanner
* Added Chrome to target accessibility package filter
